title: Global opportunity scan
summary: Search for low-obligation cash, compute hardware, grants, prizes, sponsorships, developer kits, and unusually high-value hardware opportunities that fit existing work.
instructions: Search globally for concrete ways to increase T's discretionary cash or owned compute without incorporation, employment, fixed hours, regular client commitments, substantial recurring delivery obligations, or significant capital outlay. Prioritise: individual cash grants/prizes; GPU/workstation/server/VR/MR donations, sponsorships, developer kits or surplus/refurbished programmes; exceptional low-cost hardware opportunities. Existing work only: Moneta, MonetaBench, Nemosyne, gesture intelligence, Exocortex. Verify current status and individual UK eligibility from primary sources. For survivors assess catch, sponsor benefit, what T loses, ongoing obligations, usable value, probability, urgency, strategic reuse and attention cost. For hardware assess landed cost, VRAM/bandwidth, expansion, RAM ceiling, power, compatibility, longevity and resale. Reuse prior GOMS opportunity-scan evidence to avoid dead ends. Factual exploratory email is allowed when a verified address exists, but make no commitments and accept no legal/IP/spend/travel/publicity terms. Record durable GOMS evidence every run. Only create/surface an attention item when there is a materially strong actionable candidate, important reply, or exceptional hardware buy.
